Type: rug
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Handtufted Cotton and Wool Area Rug, 4' x 6', Distressed Blue and Ivory
Colors: Blue/Ivory
Materials: wool
The distressed look of this cotton-and-wool handtufted rug will add a modern accent to your space, but the bright blue-and-ivory coloring is flexible enough to work with any decor. A semiplush pile will soften and brighten bare areas while bringing warmth and comfort. 4'W x 6'L 80% wool, 20% cotton Handtufted with a distressed pattern The medium 0.3" pile suits any indoor space. Pair with rug pad (sold separately)
